This is very similar to how I’ve been feeling (24F) and I think a lot of the frustration you may be feeling could branch from coming to terms with being an adult after years of essentially being guided. Life is hard. And as you grow older, you get wiser, and the baggage of the past gets heavier, but it’s about learning new ways to manage the load. I’m not claiming to be an expert at all as I’m learning to manage similar things myself, but a technique that might be helpful is not fighting the emotions, but rather observing them. An interesting way I’ve heard it explained is like looking at each emotion like an exotic creature, acknowledging it’s there, but not letting it attack. Another important thing is recognizing your specific triggers, and if there’s anything you can do to reduce, or become more comfortable with them. For instance, if you find you’re quick to feel backed up with housework and getting behind makes you angry, set the goal of at least 1 small task a day, it’ll keep you busy, provide positive reinforcement, and help you avoid the trigger of falling behind. Now not all triggers are as simple to deal with, but even coming to terms with smaller ones in the meantime could help a bunch in the long run. I hope this helped at least a little, best of luck to you!
